anomalies.x_power: Anomaly: X-Antibody: Power. This Digimon gets 55% more attack damage from every source.
anomalies.x_guard: Anomaly: X-Antibody: Guard. Gain 15 armor and MR, then 60% more armor and MR from every source.
anomalies.x_mind: Anomaly: X-Antibody: Mind. Gain 10 AP, then 40% more ability power from every source.
anomalies.x_bulwark: Anomaly: X-Antibody: Bulwark. Gain 40 armor and MR, tripled while above 50% HP.
anomalies.x_berserk: Anomaly: X-Antibody: Berserk. Gain 30 AP and 30% AD. Triple it below 50% HP.
anomalies.x_giant: Anomaly: X-Antibody: Giant. Gain 800 max HP.
anomalies.x_velocity: Anomaly: X-Antibody: Velocity. Gain 10% attack speed. Each cast gives 15% more attack speed for the rest of combat.
anomalies.x_ascend: Anomaly: X-Antibody: Ascension. After 10 seconds of combat, gain 50% max HP and 60% attack speed.
anomalies.dna_hunger: Anomaly: DNA Digivolution: Devour. At the start of combat, absorb the nearest ally: it leaves the fight and this Digimon gains 90% of its max HP and attack damage.
anomalies.dna_share: Anomaly: DNA Digivolution: Share. At the start of combat, adjacent allies gain 12% of this Digimon's attack damage, ability power, max HP, armor and MR.
anomalies.dna_power: Anomaly: DNA Digivolution: Absorb Power. Gain 30% AD. Each time an ally is knocked out, gain 20% of its attack damage.
anomalies.dna_energy: Anomaly: DNA Digivolution: Absorb Energy. Gain 30 AP. Each time an ally is knocked out, gain 20% of its ability power.
anomalies.dna_mana: Anomaly: DNA Digivolution: Nothing Wasted. Start with 20 more mana and gain 15% attack speed. When an ally is knocked out, gain 70% of its mana.
anomalies.dna_partners: Anomaly: DNA Digivolution: Partners. Two Garurumon join the fight beside this Digimon, each with 25% of its max HP and 40% of its attack damage.
anomalies.dna_familiar: Anomaly: DNA Digivolution: Spare Body. When knocked out, a ShellNumemon takes its place with this Digimon's max HP, armor and MR.
anomalies.dna_shield: Anomaly: DNA Digivolution: Guardian Link. At the start of combat and every 8 seconds, shields itself and the 2 lowest-health allies for 12% of its max HP.
anomalies.dh_fireball: Anomaly: Digital Hazard: Fireball. Each cast also throws a fireball (two with 120+ max mana): enemies in the blast take 6% of their max HP as true damage and burn.
anomalies.dh_laser: Anomaly: Digital Hazard: Laser Eyes. Every second, a laser hits enemies in a 3-hex line toward its target for 80% of its ability power as magic damage and burns them.
anomalies.dh_slime: Anomaly: Digital Hazard: Slime Time. Every 2 seconds, deals 110% of its ability power as magic damage to adjacent enemies and heals for the damage dealt.
anomalies.dh_cooker: Anomaly: Digital Hazard: Meltdown. Every second, deals 3.5% of its max HP as magic damage to nearby enemies. The radius grows every 6 seconds.
anomalies.dh_finisher: Anomaly: Digital Hazard: Finisher. Its attacks and abilities knock out enemies below 18% HP.
anomalies.dh_cuts: Anomaly: Digital Hazard: Thousand Cuts. Attacks deal 25 bonus true damage, plus 10 more for each earlier cut on that target (scales with star level).
anomalies.dh_dragonsoul: Anomaly: Digital Hazard: Dragon Soul. Its first attack on each new target deals 16% of the target's max HP as true damage.
anomalies.dh_lastchance: Anomaly: Digital Hazard: Last Chance. The first time it would be knocked out, it returns at full HP with 50% attack speed and 20% omnivamp, but loses 10% max HP every second.
anomalies.dh_thorns: Anomaly: Digital Hazard: Thornskin. Gain 60 armor and MR. When damaged, deals 40% of the damage taken to adjacent enemies as magic damage (once a second).
anomalies.u_crest: Anomaly: Crest Copy. Gain a Crest for one of this Digimon's traits (the one closest to its next breakpoint). 6 gold if it has none.
anomalies.u_dual: Anomaly: Dual Wielding. Gain 2 completed items that suit this Digimon.

powerUps.burst: Digi-Core path: Burst Mode. Deals 12% more damage, 25% more after its first takedown each combat.
powerUps.xanti: Digi-Core path: X-Antibody. When hit, gains 4 armor (physical) or 8 MR (magic), up to 90 in total.
powerUps.dark: Digi-Core path: Dark Digivolution. Gains 22% attack damage and 10% omnivamp, but loses 1% max HP every second.
powerUps.warp: Digi-Core path: Warp Digivolution. Gains 8% attack damage, 8 AP, 10 armor and MR, and deals 5% more damage.
powerUps.armor: Digi-Core path: Armor Digivolution. Starts combat with a 25% max HP shield. While shielded, gains 30% attack speed.
powerUps.mode: Digi-Core path: Mode Change. At the start of combat, it and its nearest ally gain an 18% max HP shield.
powerUps.slide: Digi-Core path: Slide Evolution. When it switches targets, its next attack deals 120% bonus damage as magic damage.
powerUps.spirit: Digi-Core path: Spirit Evolution. The first time it drops below 40% HP, heals 25% max HP and gains 25% attack speed.
powerUps.deathx: Digi-Core path: Death-X Evolution. Leaps to the enemy backline at the start of combat and gains 30% crit chance and 10% crit damage.
powerUps.biomerge: Digi-Core path: Biomerge. Gains 3% attack damage and 3 AP every second, up to 30 times.
powerUps.mega: Digi-Core path: Mega Digivolution. Gains 40% attack damage.
powerUps.sage: Digi-Core path: Sage Evolution. Gains 25 AP.
powerUps.golem: Digi-Core path: Golem Form. Gains 30% max HP.
powerUps.speed: Digi-Core path: Speed Form. Gains 30% attack speed.
powerUps.overwrite: Digi-Core path: Overwrite. Gains 30% crit chance and 15% crit damage; its abilities can critically strike.
powerUps.matrix: Digi-Core path: Matrix Evolution. Its max mana is 25% lower and it starts combat with 10 extra mana.
powerUps.overdrive: Digi-Core path: Overdrive. Deals 12% more damage. After its first takedown or 10 seconds of combat, stuns enemies within 2 hexes for 1.5 seconds and deals 20% more damage for the rest of combat.
powerUps.atomic: Digi-Core path: Atomic Core. Stores 10% max HP at the start of combat and 2% more every second. When it falls, deals the stored amount as magic damage to enemies within 2 hexes.
powerUps.thorn: Digi-Core path: Thorn Armor. When attacked, deals 50 + 5% of its max HP as magic damage to adjacent enemies (1 second cooldown).
powerUps.glacier: Digi-Core path: Glacier Mode. Gains 15% attack speed. Attacks slow the target's attack speed by 30% for 2 seconds.
powerUps.inferno: Digi-Core path: Inferno Mode. Its abilities burn their targets, and it deals 15% more damage to burning enemies.
powerUps.hunter: Digi-Core path: Hunter Mode. Deals 8% more damage, and 30% more to enemies below 50% HP.
powerUps.guardian: Digi-Core path: Guardian Mode. Gains 30 armor and MR. Adjacent allies gain 10 armor and MR.
powerUps.ascend: Digi-Core path: Ascension. After 6 seconds of combat, deals 40% more damage.

col_justimon.blitz: Form: Blitz Arm. Duelist stance. Gains the Duelist trait and 30% attack speed. Its ability strikes the 2 nearest enemies several times and cuts their armor.
col_justimon.critical: Form: Critical Arm. Executioner stance. Gains the Executioner trait and 20% crit chance. Its ability hits the lowest-health enemy within 3 hexes, stuns it for 1.5 seconds and splashes adjacent enemies.
col_justimon.trinity: Form: Trinity Arm. Juggernaut stance. Gains the Juggernaut trait and 400 HP. Its ability takes 50% less damage for 2 seconds, then smashes its target and everything around it.

col_labramon.ballista: Form: Ballistamon. Tank partner. 20% more HP and 15 armor and MR. Its ability gains a shield, taunts nearby enemies and stuns them briefly.
col_labramon.dorulu: Form: Dorulumon. Diver partner. 30% more attack damage and 20% omnivamp. Its ability drills through to the lowest-health enemy, double damage below 50% HP.
col_labramon.sparrow: Form: Sparrowmon. Ranged partner. Attacks from 4 hexes with 25% more attack speed. Its ability gives it 50% attack speed for 5 seconds and fires at 3 enemies.
